The Thermal Design Power of the Intel Core i7-9700E (8 cores) is 65 W, as listed by [Spectra](https://spectra.de/en/Products/IPC-Components/Processors/Intel-Core-i7-9700E) and [CPU-Monkey](https://www.cpu-monkey.com/en/cpu-intel_core_i7_9700e). I found no conflicting TDP figures in the results, but I didn't reach Intel's own ARK page to confirm it there.
CONFIDENCE: 90
